verdict.rationale: Browserbase has its own fetch capability that converts any URL into markdown or JSON for agents (docs-3). Its browser platform claims to handle CAPTCHAs and login walls (docs-10, docs-8), which addresses the blocking and rendering parts of the story. The evidence is only marketing-level, though, so the depth of the clean-text output is unproven. missing for 10: detailed docs on the fetch/markdown API (cleanup or boilerplate stripping, LLM-ready formatting), evidence that blocking and anti-bot handling apply to the fetch path itself rather than only to full browser sessions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get clean LLM-ready text directly instead of dealing with blocking, rendering, and messy HTML myself

citations.quote: Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
When your workflow requires a form, a CAPTCHA, or a login prompt, it's handled.
Your agent logs in, navigates, and pulls data from any website, login walls included.
